notes.title: Sphere Complex 1.3 Released
notes.notes:
Some minor and major issues have been dealt with in the latest patch. In order to help progression, level 4 "Hieroglyphics" has undergone changes.

- Level music restored
- Beginner level 4 moving object pattern changed.
- Beginner level 4 physics object changed.

notes.title: Sphere Complex 1.2 Released
notes.notes:
We've fixed a few things server side which should give us better reliability and error handling. There is also a few client side things which have been fixed:

- Updated Expert level "The Climb" medal times.
- Fixed SteamVR from launching when game is started.
- Fixed some walls in "Just Run"

notes.title: Sphere Complex 1.1
notes.notes:
Sphere Complex 1.1 has been uploaded and a number of small issues have been addressed. Sphere League has been turned back on and should be available from the multiplayer lobby. Fixed the ball traveling through certain walls at high speed on some maps. Fixed the level "The Connection" from loading and kicking the player back to the lobby.

Thank you all for your support and feedback. We hope we can continue to update and make Sphere Complex a better game!

notes.title: Sphere Complex -- OC Game Studios maiden release
notes.notes:
[b]November 18th, 2016 - Columbus, OH[/b] - OC Game Studio, LLC. has announced its 1st title release “Sphere Complex” for PC available on Steam.

[i]Sphere Complex is a 3D platformer where you roll, jump and boost a path through over 40 single player levels in Sphere Complex! Race against yourself with ghost saves of your best times and compete via our online leader boards. Customize your game with multiple skins and colors or make your own maps using our in-game level editor!


Enjoy 3 multiplayer game modes with up to 8 of your friends. You can go head to head in custom race maps, blow each other up in the battle arena or compete in Sphere League to score the most points for your team! However you play, you’re sure to have a ball!
[/i]


Founded in late 2014, OC Game Studio is an Independent game development company based out of Columbus, Ohio.  Their mission to create original, challenging, and creative content for gamers of all ages and skill levels.
